nodes.name: _resolve_db_path
nodes.summary: Resolves the SQLite database file path, auto-selecting the test database when pytest is active (via sys.modules or PYTEST_CURRENT_TEST) to enforce production/test isolation.

nodes.name: _connect
nodes.summary: Opens a SQLite connection using the resolved DB path, enabling WAL journal mode and a busy timeout; this is the single canonical connection entry point required by all routers.

nodes.name: initialize_database.py
nodes.summary: Defines `_init_db`, a single large function that creates every core SQLite table (studies, arms, epochs, visits, activities, cells, timelines, instances, audits, and related entities) on a fresh database.

nodes.name: _init_db
nodes.summary: Creates every core SQLite table for a fresh database (studies, arms, epochs, elements, visits, activities, matrix cells, timelines, timings, instances, biomedical concepts, amendments, organizations, roles, and their audit tables) using CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS statements.

nodes.name: migrate_database.py
nodes.summary: Library of ~108 small, idempotent schema-migration functions (new columns, new tables, audit tables, backfills, data repairs) that are individually imported and invoked by `app.py`'s lifespan startup to incrementally evolve the SQLite schema across releases.
nodes.languageNotes: Each migration is a standalone, independently-callable function rather than a numbered migration file, so ordering and idempotency are managed entirely by the import list and internal existence checks in app.py's lifespan.
